title: Signer abstraction, no private keys required in-process
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 6.2 Key Management; QR Code Generation, 13. Reference script.

statements.label: Signer abstraction, no private keys required in-process
statements.requirement: Signing SHALL go through a Signer interface (algorithm, DSC, sign(bytes)). The issuer SHALL NOT need access to private key material, so HSM, KMS, PKCS#11 and Android Keystore signers can be used. A software signer SHALL be provided for tests only, in the testkit module.

sources.quote: Use of HSMs for signing health certificates is highly encouraged.
a real issuer holds its private keys in an HSM
